state.get: Read the active project, source files, boards, ports, toolchain and latest build result.
ports.list: List actual serial ports and their hardware identifiers.
project.readFile: Read a source file in the active project. The path is relative to the project root.
file.write: Create or overwrite a source file in the active project. Read existing content first and follow the user's instructions.
config.set: Save the complete project configuration, including board, port, toolchain and Flash partitions. Custom toolchain paths must refer to executables trusted by the user.
build.run: Compile saved source files and return firmware artifacts, actual Flash/RAM usage and tool output.
flash.run: Flash built firmware to the selected device. This changes device storage. Set confirm=true only after the user authorizes flashing.
device.probe: Identify the serial device's chip and Flash without writing storage. The device may reset.
toolchain.install: Download the official toolchain and ESP32 core. Set confirm=true only after the user authorizes downloading and installing.
serial.open: Open the serial monitor with optional port and baudRate. Read output through events.poll.
serial.close: Close the serial monitor and release the port.
serial.write: Send data text to the open serial port.
events.poll: Read build, status and serial events. Pass the previous cursor as after. dropped=true indicates older events have expired.
bridge.failed: Pipe connection failed. Ensure Blode Studio is running and check the connection file specified by BLODE_CONNECTION_FILE or --connection.
